speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm a huge rat. Hoisted by my own spam filter. I put you there after you forwarded me a picture of a cat playing the piano entitled This is funny.

speaker: Leonard
text: What am I doing here, spam filter? I'm getting to it.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I assure you, you'll be sorry you wasted your money on an iPod when Microsoft comes out with theirs.

speaker: Benny
text: When I saw that, that was hilarious. Okay, do you have an opinion about everything? You just assume you're always right.

speaker: Sheldon
text: It's not an assumption. Change seats with me. I don't like this spot. I have to keep turning my head.

speaker: Sheldon
text: We don't watch Babylon 5 in this apartment. Because no one likes Babylon 5. Me too.

speaker: Leonard
text: I like it. There you go. Three against one.

speaker: Sheldon
text: They don't get a vote. It's one against one. And according to the roommate agreement, all ties will be settled by me.

speaker: Leonard
text: And I said no to that.

speaker: Sheldon
text: And I said yes. And I settle all ties.
